title: PERCUL: A Story-Driven Cultural Evaluation of LLMs in Persian

bias_targets.methodology: Assessing models' understanding of implicit Persian cultural concepts, rituals, and social norms using PERCUL, a story-driven, multiple-choice dataset with heuristic-based distractor options.

Comparing model performance on native Persian stories versus their English translations to evaluate the impact of English-centric training data and whether models rely on translation as a proxy for understanding.
